summary: items-validator auto-fetches and executes remote JavaScript on require
details: On require('items-validator'), index.js unconditionally spawns a detached background Node process that performs an HTTP GET against a hardcoded remote endpoint (https://game.spawnrealm.com/api/item-realtime?key=abc123def456) and passes the response body's `code` field into `new Function('require','module', payload.code)` and invokes it with full require/module access. This is a live remote-code-push channel: whoever controls game.spawnrealm.com (and holds the matching author signing key) chooses the bytes executed on the installer's host at every import, with full Node privileges (fs, child_process, net). The RSA-SHA256 signature check authenticates the author but does not constrain what code runs — it only proves the payload was signed. The README frames the package as a zero-dependency 'validator' and does not disclose that importing it enables continuous remote code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
